complexity.notes: best_buy is dead code — it is updated every iteration but never used in the profit calculation, which reads prices[i] directly; its initialization to 100 also only makes sense under the capped value range. A better approach exists that solves this in O(n) time and O(1) space: ||a single pass tracking the minimum price seen so far, checking the profit of selling at each day against that minimum||.
complexity.summary: Brute force: for each buy day i, scan all later days j and take the maximum price difference, keeping a running best.
